ThingDef.Name: ST_RankPip_ApparelBase
ThingDef.label: rank pips (base)
ThingDef.description: Rank pips worn on the uniform to denote officer rank.

ThingDef.label: rank pips (cadet)
ThingDef.description: The initial rank held by Starfleet Academy cadets during their training period.

ThingDef.label: rank pips (ensign)
ThingDef.description: The most junior officer rank. Rank bestowed on newly-commissioned officers when they graduated from Starfleet Academy

ThingDef.label: rank pips (lieutenant jg)
ThingDef.description: Junior grade officer rank. Rank bestowed on officers with some years of service and experience.

ThingDef.label: rank pips (lieutenant)
ThingDef.description: Standard officer rank. Rank bestowed on officers with considerable service time and leadership experience.

ThingDef.label: rank pips (lieutenant commander)
ThingDef.description: Senior officer rank. Rank bestowed on officers with significant leadership experience and command potential.

ThingDef.label: rank pips (commander)
ThingDef.description: High-ranking officer. Rank bestowed on officers with extensive command experience and strategic acumen.

ThingDef.label: rank pips (captain)
ThingDef.description: Senior command officer. Rank bestowed on officers with exceptional leadership and command capabilities.
